evidence.title: Beste UI - Production-ready shadcn/tailwind blocks & components

name: Beste UI
summary: Catalog of 2,236 shadcn/ui blocks, 1,325 pieces and 292 components for React and Tailwind, installed by shadcn CLI or MCP.
description: A catalog of production-ready UI built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS: 2,236 full-page blocks in 48 categories (hero, feature, pricing, footer, navigation …), 1,325 small pieces and 292 styled primitives, plus 23 whole pages assembled from blocks. Everything installs into your repo as copy-paste React source with the shadcn CLI (npx shadcn add https://beste.dev/r/<name>) or through an MCP server for AI agents; every asset ships in Radix and Base UI flavors. Pieces, components and 168 blocks are free; a one-time Pro licence ($159, $359 team) unlocks the rest.
contains: 2,095-item shadcn registry; llms.txt says 2,095 blocks in 48 categories, 168 free
install: npx shadcn add https://beste.dev/r/<name> or MCP server
every asset ships in Radix and Base UI flavors
React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 copy-paste source, no runtime dependency
theming via CSS variables, dark mode, radius and tones
